# IT Interview Coach

> AI-powered Telegram bot for technical interview preparation. Targets Russian-speaking IT professionals (CIS market) and Spanish-speaking IT professionals. Available at https://t.me/ITInterviewCoach_Bot?start=src_llmstxt_root

## Product

IT Interview Coach is a Telegram bot that simulates technical job interviews and helps IT professionals prepare for them. It supports Backend engineers, QA engineers, and ML/Data Science specialists at Junior, Middle, and Senior levels.

## Core features

- **Mock interviews** — AI-generated questions tailored to specialization and level, with instant evaluation of each answer
- **Experience Deep-Dive** (Прожарка опыта / Análisis profundo de experiencia) — behavioural interview simulator based on positions from the user's uploaded CV
- **Topic Preparation** — targeted practice on specific topics (databases, concurrency, API design, algorithms, etc.)
- **Live Coding** — 4-phase coding sessions: clarify → solve → review → discuss, with full debrief
- **CV / Resume Analysis** — ATS score 0–100, 9 deterministic penalty detectors, structured recommendations, and conversational CV consultation
- **LinkedIn Audit** — profile analysis, weekly metric tracking (SSI, profile views, search appearances), post tone checker
- **Voice Input (STT)** — answer interview questions by voice in Telegram (Premium)
- **English Mode** — full interview flow in English (Premium)

## Supported specializations

- Backend (Python, databases, concurrency, REST, observability, security, event-driven architecture)
- QA (test design, API testing, automation, mobile, contract testing, security testing)
- ML / Data Science (statistics, classical ML, neural networks, LLM/NLP, time series, production systems)
- DevOps (Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud, Terraform, monitoring, logging, networking, infrastructure as code, SRE)
- DA soon (SQL, BI, data visualization, exploratory data analysis, statistics, ETL/ELT, data modeling, dashboards, experimentation, business metrics) 

## Guides and content pages

In-depth guides on interview preparation, available in Russian and Spanish. Each page covers a specific topic with definitions, example questions by level, and preparation strategy.

Russian:

- [Мок-собеседование: что это и как проходит](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/mock-interview/) — what a mock interview is, how it differs from a real one, the 5-step process, example questions by level
- [Анализ резюме с ATS-оценкой](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/resume-analysis/) — how ATS ranking works, all 9 resume penalty detectors with point values, how to raise the score
- [Подготовка к собеседованию Backend](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/backend-interview/) — 6 core topics, key term definitions (ACID, isolation levels, idempotency, N+1, outbox), questions by level
- [Подготовка к собеседованию QA](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/qa-interview/) — test design, API testing, automation; manual vs automation interviews; questions by level
- [Подготовка к собеседованию ML](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/ml-interview/) — statistics, classical ML, neural networks, LLM/NLP; Middle and Senior questions
- [Live coding на собеседовании](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/live-coding/) — how the format works, the 4 phases, what the interviewer evaluates, common mistakes
- [Прожарка опыта: поведенческое интервью](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/experience-deep-dive/) — behavioural interview based on your CV, why candidates fail experience questions, STAR structure
- [Поведенческое интервью: метод STAR](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/behavioral-interview/) — what a behavioural interview is, what it evaluates, the STAR framework with sample answers, question categories and common mistakes
- [Подготовка к DevOps-собеседованию](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/devops-interview/) — DevOps interview topics (Linux, CI/CD, Kubernetes, IaC, cloud, observability), example questions by level and common mistakes
- [Подготовка к собеседованию Data Analyst](https://itinterviewcoach.com/ru/data-analyst-interview/) — Data Analyst interview topics (SQL, statistics, A/B testing, product metrics, visualization); the DA practice track is coming soon

## Pricing

- **Free** — €0 forever. 3 sessions/month, 1 CV analysis/day, Russian/English/Spanish interface
- **Basic** — €10/month or 650 Telegram Stars. 20 sessions/month, 3 CV analyses/day, 7-day free trial
- **Premium** — €20/month or 1250 Telegram Stars. Unlimited sessions, 5 CV analyses/day, English mode, voice input, LinkedIn audit

Payment methods: card via Dodo Payments (EUR), Telegram Stars (XTR).

## Languages

- Interface: Russian, English, and Spanish
- Interview sessions: Russian and Spanish (Free/Basic); Russian, Spanish, and English (Premium adds English mode)
- Markets: Russian-speaking IT professionals (Russia, CIS, Georgia, Eastern Europe) and Spanish-speaking IT professionals
